Package the new battle PNGs and native common control SVGs.

Byte identity checks cover69 assets and97 mappings; swapping cannon for
sailor is rejected and restoring it passes. Original32 globe hashes pass.
Actual hosted dromon combat works at1280x720 and390x844, with fixed Greek
fire and auto ammo repeat badge. Full prompts and screenshots retained.
Integrate the required Blockside0bb02919 core and regenerate battle.html.

👥 參與者：@meadow
